patch_description: This approach uses a deterministic population of broadly different 14-point configurations, followed by a diameter-normalized force-based feasibility annealing stage. The annealer repels the currently short distances while contracting long distances, allowing symmetry to break before exact optimization. The strongest diverse candidates are then polished with an active-set nonlinear diameter-packing formulation using SLSQP, maximizing the minimum squared separation subject to every squared distance being at most one. This combines global basin exploration with an exact constrained final solve rather than relying primarily on one symmetric local start.
